name: Dual-Path Holographic Laser Rendering
aliases: Volumetric display system with LC-SLM and 3D laser scanner
definition: A volumetric display system that renders palm-sized volumetric contents in real space by splitting a femtosecond laser into two optical paths. One path uses a liquid-crystal spatial light modulator (LC-SLM) for holographic voxel generation, and the other uses a 3D laser scanner. A single volume is formed by the cooperative dual-path rendering.
